about: The lane registry (spec docs/superpowers/specs/2026-10-28-e2e-reliability-design.md, lanes table). A suite with no lane is backbone: red or green, a PR's red when its diff reaches it. A lane entry is tolerant (its result depends on an AI answer, the clock or the outside world, named in `input`), suspended (flips red then green on one commit; shown, never blocks) or retired; every lane entry names when it returns or retires in `returns`. tools/pr-verdict.py shows a red tolerant or suspended suite grey on a PR; it reads this file from the PR's BASE branch, so a PR that edits it is judged by main's copy and its entry counts after it merges. Moving a suite out of the backbone is an expectation change (spec rule E): the PR names the input and why. First cut 28 Oct 2026, from the week's reds (tools/e2e_weekly.py). Every backbone suite, including a new unlisted suite, defaults to aiMissesMax 0: any ask without a stored answer fails. Only tolerant, suspended and retired lanes or a named aiMissesException reason bypass that ceiling (owner, 31 Oct 2026: no external-world flakiness in the backbone). A step can be suspended by name (top-level `steps`: {suite: {exact step name: entry}}): it runs and shows its result but never fails the job or blocks a beta (tools/suspend-flip.mjs proposes it from a step red on code unchanged since a green; spec row 33, 31 Oct 2026).

qualityai.why: A live Jobs check on the golden postings measures the model's facts, scores and judge texts as rates.
qualityai.returns: Stays tolerant: it measures the live model.

notion-real.why: The one suite on a real Notion workspace (cadence night-report: once a night, reported, never in the beta or a PR): what the in-memory stand-in cannot prove depends on Notion's own pages and rate limits, which are not ours.
notion-real.returns: Stays tolerant: it tests Notion itself.

wander.why: Owner, 1 Nov 2026: the beta keeps only the critical journeys; wander is an explorer that walks a seeded random path and reports once a night (cadence night-report), so what it finds depends on the path and the timing of that walk, never on this commit alone.
wander.returns: Stays tolerant: it is a nightly report, not a gate.

interactions.why: Owner, 1 Nov 2026: the beta keeps only the critical journeys; interactions is a finder that clicks every safe control and watches pages for late shifts, and reports once a night (cadence night-report), so its result depends on layout timing.
interactions.returns: Stays tolerant: it is a nightly report, not a gate.

quality.why: Owner, 1 Nov 2026: the beta keeps only the critical journeys; quality measures the model's facts and scores on golden postings from stored answers and reports once a night (cadence night-report), so a red is a measurement, not a verdict on this commit.
quality.returns: Stays tolerant: it is a nightly report, not a gate.

personas.why: Owner, 31 Oct 2026: personas reports only, like qualityai: it runs and shows its result but never holds a beta, because its live asks depend on a model's answers. The stored-answers migration (#2600) was dropped by the owner on 31 Oct 2026; its live asks stay.
personas.returns: Stays tolerant: it reports a live model's answers on fictional personas; it returns to the backbone only if the owner asks for its asks to be stored.

explore.aiMissesException: The manual-only AI explorer deliberately spends model credit when explicitly requested; cadence manual excludes it from scheduled and release gates.
